description: Screening of a scope's patches that needs neighbours across cells: a patch whose pooled 2011 offset departs from the weighted median of patches within refs.screen.near_m (old measure_patches.flag_change), and cells whose median offset is more than refs.screen.cell_gross_m from the scope median (quarries, earthworks; old fit_field.GROSS_TILE). Patches not listed are not excluded.

columns.name: deviation_m
columns.description: Offset minus neighbour median (change_suspect) or cell median minus scope median (gross_cell)
